thought.text: Fresh start succeeded with openldap healthy. Let me verify the 10 LDAP users were loaded on first start.

reasoning_content: The fresh start succeeded, and openldap also became ready. Let me check whether the LDAP user was loaded in this first-time startup.

action.command: su - dev -c 'cd /workspace && export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH && docker exec ddev-tfm-fachplanung-openldap ldapsearch -x -H ldap://localhost -b "dc=example,dc=org" "(objectClass=inetOrgPerson)" uid 2>&1 | grep -E "^uid|result"; echo "===COUNT==="; docker exec ddev-tfm-fachplanung-openldap ldapsearch -x -H ldap://localhost -b "ou=people,dc=example,dc=org" "(uid=*)" uid 2>&1 | grep -c "^uid:"'
